subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

(A) The new movie was highly anticipated by fans of the franchise.

(B) As the lights dimmed, the audience grew quiet in anticipation.

(C) The movie began with an exciting action sequence that had the audience on the edge of their seats.

(D) The movie theatre was packed with people eager to see it.
solution:
The correct answer is: **ADBC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sentence **A **introduces the topic of the new movie and its anticipation among fans.
 
• Sentence **D **sets the scene in the movie theatre and highlights the audience's excitement.
 
• Sentence **B **reinforces the idea of the theatre being packed with eager viewers.
 
• Sentence **C **provides the action-packed opening sequence that captures the audience's attention.
 
• This sentence describes the beginning of the movie, specifically mentioning an exciting action sequence that captivated the audience.
 
• In this order, the paragraph flows logically from the anticipation of the movie to the crowded theatre, the moment before the movie starts, and finally, the description of the movie's exciting opening.
 
• The coherence in the sequence creates a well-structured and meaningful narrative.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
